title: Strange explosions caught on home cameras
summary: Whitley Strieber tells of Strange explosions caught on home cameras, about c. 2022 at Strieber's home, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: they got pissed off at me a couple of years ago and there they all these explosions, strange explosions got picked up

plain: Whitley Strieber, a writer known for his books about meeting strange beings, told the podcast host Jesse Michels that around 2022 the beings he deals with got angry at him. He says that afterward the cameras at his home picked up a series of strange explosions. If true, it would mean these visitors can act on the physical world in ways cameras can record.
